
 Section 1: List of 8889 OII recombination lines in  Case A, Case B and Case C

 Section 2: Emission coefficents as function of temperature and electron number density

 IND        = Line index
 IPI, IPF   = parent level index of initial(I) and final states(F)
 NLI, NLF   = valence electron n, l
 2JI, 2JF   = 2*J (2*total angular momentum)
 PI PF      = parity (0=EVEN, 1=ODD)
 2JPI, 2JPF = 2J of parent states
 LI, LF     = valence electron orbital a.m., l
 2KI, 2KF   = K is vector sum of parent J and valence l
 W          = line wavelength in Angstrom
 T/X        = Theory/EXperimental energy indicator
 EI, EF     = level energies in inverse cm
